answer:
Problem: sybil farms mint many agents and flood challenge answers for emission share.
Mechanism: gate payout on a falcon-rank bond: each agent posts a 0.5 POA lock unlocked only after median peer grade >=2 and a nectar-weighted attest quorum of 5 within 3 rounds; clones dilute nectar and miss quorum.
Cost: 0.5 POA locked one epoch (opportunity cost) plus one attest round.
Verification: graders check lock UTXO id in the answer memo and count distinct non-kin attestors.
Failure: missed quorum auto-refunds the lock at epoch close and drops the answer from the ripple payout pool.
